project_type: Flask web app with multi-page SPA-style navigation (no framework, vanilla JS)
build_system: No build step for frontend. Flask serves static files directly. Dockerfile uses gunicorn.
test_framework: No automated tests present in the project
verification_instructions: 1. Run python -c 'import app' to verify no syntax errors. 2. Visually verify CSS/JS have no syntax errors by checking file structure. 3. Verify HTML template renders without errors.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No automated test suite. Verification is limited to syntax validation and structural checks.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT touch downloader.js or TikTok-related code. Do NOT add new features beyond what is specified.
key_patterns: CSS is split into multiple files (variables.css, base.css, components.css, layout.css, makima-ai.css, responsive.css). JS is split per feature (makima-ai.js, downloader.js, ui.js). Navigation is SPA-style via ui.js navigateTo(). MAKIMA AI renders into #viewMakimaAI container. The chat uses localStorage for persistence. Input is currently an <input type=text> not <textarea>.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), templates/index.html (single HTML), static/css/ (8 CSS files), static/js/ (10 JS files), static/img/ (images)
